items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: I'm with Eddie South's band now, see.

ctx.x: That was my tutor too. You remember Paul Ash? Yes, I used to hear him at the theater down there. Oriental was one of those theaters. Well he was at the Oriental and the McVickers. The McVickers, that's where I had him. Yeah. I used to take Lesman Wren. Then I got bigger than him.
I was at the Chicago Fair there. Mm-hmm. I was lookin' down at him. I'm with Eddie South's band now, see. You remember Eddie South? Yeah.
Oh sure, I know him. I mean, it's drama. It goes all over the world with Eddie. Did you go to Europe?
